title: Automated immutable artifact registration, verification, and selection
intended_behavior: A trusted successful HiveCI result resolves its repository and tag to an immutable OCI manifest digest.
The result is bound to the original service, build, repository, tag, manifest digest, and signed CI provenance.
Automatic and build-result action paths create one deduplicated canonical artifact without copied identifiers.
Mutable-only, mismatched, and unverifiable references are refused.
The UI exposes the manifest digest plus verification, signature, SBOM, scan, policy, and CI provenance.
Advanced signed manual registration is available only when explicitly enabled by policy.
